purpose: Teach: 打倒/降伏/介在/適法/内在/剥奪/受刑/労働党

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 蓮さん、独裁政権打倒の市民運動を論文で扱いましたね
lines.en: Ren, you wrote your paper on citizen movements against authoritarian regimes, didn't you?
lines.style: Warm, inviting tone. Gentle confirmation, not interrogation. Leans forward slightly with genuine interest. Opens space for him to expand.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい、戦時降伏の調印過程を論文で扱いました
lines.en: Yes — I focused on the surrender agreements signed during wartime.
lines.style: Careful, methodical delivery. Slight pause before the explanation, choosing words precisely. Quiet conviction. Maintains eye contact but speaks to the work, not for approval.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 蓮さん、外国勢力の介在事例を論文で扱いましたね
lines.en: And you examined cases where foreign powers intervened, is that right?
lines.style: Thoughtful, measured pace. Slight lift at the end — genuinely curious where this is heading. Nods slightly, inviting him deeper into his own analysis.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい、戦時下の適法な戦闘行為の研究を論文で扱いました
lines.en: Yes — the research looked at lawful combat operations conducted under wartime conditions.
lines.style: Steady, controlled. Words land with precision. No hesitation, but not rushed. Treats the subject with gravity. Slight tension in the shoulders.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 組織に内在する問題の研究を論文で扱いましたね
lines.en: So you also investigated the internal contradictions within these systems?
lines.style: Perceptive, almost gently probing. She's connecting dots. Warm but not soft — respecting the complexity. Leans back, giving him room to think.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい、戦時下の市民権剥奪の歴史を論文で扱いました
lines.en: Yes — I traced the history of rights deprivation under wartime law.
lines.style: Quiet intensity. He's moved into difficult territory and he knows it. Words come carefully, each one deliberate. Slight tightness in his jaw. Almost reverential about the subject matter.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 蓮さん、受刑者の社会復帰研究を論文で扱いましたね
lines.en: And you researched prisoner rehabilitation and social reintegration too?
lines.style: Gentle redirection, almost a lifeline. She's noticing something in him — a heaviness. Still curious, but with an undercurrent of care. Softer attack on the opening word.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい、英国労働党の政策史を論文で扱いました
lines.en: Yes — the focus was on the Labour Party's policy evolution in Britain.
lines.style: Brief, almost closing off. Tired clarity. He's given his answer and is ready to move on. A small exhale of relief that the topic has shifted. Slight disconnect between topic and tone.
